cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said clear the table so confidently that I cleared the spreadsheet. I'll help investigate where the figures went.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant the lunch table. You've emptied our sales figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, the figures. Now we've located the gap, I'll search the earlier copies.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The history says you deleted them at twelve. We can undo it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, a recovery plan. Show me the undo step and I'll do exactly that. We can report that the figures are back before the meeting.

reason: Create specific misunderstood language or copied behavior, then make the subsequent Drive tactics respond to B rather than merely add confident phrases.
